readerCopy.body: Being seen can become easier in an area where embarrassment or judgment once felt almost guaranteed. When the Sun trines Chiron, identity and sensitivity reinforce each other, allowing difficult history to exist beside current recognition without canceling it. A setback, mistake, changed appearance, or period of feeling unprepared can become part of the story without remaining the reason to hide. The old reaction does not have to disappear before the present deserves visibility.
